name: Smart factory for EV manufacturing (14 weeks)
context: a smart factory course on EV manufacturing

Module 1 — EV manufacturing fundamentals: EV architecture: battery, electric motor, inverter, power electronics, thermal management, and vehicle control systems.
Manufacturing flow: incoming materials, component production, battery pack assembly, vehicle assembly, and end-of-line testing.
Production planning, takt time, cycle time, throughput, OEE, scrap, and rework.
Introduction to Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and value stream mapping.
Module 2 — Industrial automation and con: Sensors, actuators, motors, drives, and machine safety.
Industrial robots, cobots, AGVs, and AMRs.
Industrial communication: OPC UA, Modbus TCP, and PROFINET.
Interlocks, alarms, emergency stops, and safety systems.
Module 3 — Smart factory architecture: MES (Manufacturing Execution System), ERP, SCADA, PLC, and CMMS.
IIoT gateways, edge computing, and industrial data pipelines.
Production orders, work orders, recipes, and electronic work instructions.
Product genealogy, serial numbers, traceability, and digital records.
OT cybersecurity, network segmentation, and access control.
Module 4 — Industrial IoT and data analy: Data collection, timestamps, units, validation, and missing values.
SQL and Python for manufacturing data analysis.
MQTT and OPC UA data integration.
Dashboards using Grafana or Power BI.
OEE analysis, downtime Pareto charts, and production trend analysis.
Module 5 — AI for smart manufacturing: Manufacturing data preparation and feature engineering.
Model evaluation, false positives, false negatives, and drift.
Human review and safe integration into production decisions.
Module 6 — Digital twins and production: Digital twin concepts and real-time synchronization.
Module 7 — EV-specific manufacturing and: Battery manufacturing and pack assembly: cell, module, and pack manufacturing concepts.
Battery manufacturing and pack assembly: battery traceability and manufacturing records.
Battery manufacturing and pack assembly: weld quality monitoring and inspection.
Battery manufacturing and pack assembly: Battery Management System (BMS) testing.
Battery manufacturing and pack assembly: thermal, electrical, and process safety.
E-motor and power electronics: motor and inverter assembly.
E-motor and power electronics: torque, alignment, electrical, and functional tests.
E-motor and power electronics: process parameters and component genealogy.
Quality management and end-of-line testing: Statistical Process Control (SPC).
Quality management and end-of-line testing: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
Quality management and end-of-line testing: root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Quality management and end-of-line testing: functional validation and electronic test records.
